Studies10,11 of borage oil (another source of gamolenic acid) also found no overall efficacy in adults or children with atopic eczema, although one study not- ed a suggestion of benefit in a subgroup of patients.10 In a study12 of a group of formula-fed infants with a high maternal familial risk of developing atopic eczema, borage oil supplementation did not prevent the expression of atopy, although it showed a ten- dency to alleviate the severity of the condition later in infancy.
